newsitem.title: USA: America West Airlines launches new internet service. [CORRECTED 23:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: America West Airlines launches new internet service. [CORRECTED 23:15 GMT]

text.p: America West Airlines annouced a new internet service to assist its customers in booking summer travel.
Effortless Ticketing Online(TM) will offer all flight-booking capabilities at the internet address:

The new address will not yet serve its cargo customers, a company spokewoman said, but it does anticipate a similar service for cargo to be launched sometime next year. (Corrects from "launched before the end of the summer")
